name: berkeDark pool
state: judged by the author on 2026-11-10. The single source of berkeDark: the editor theme, the browser theme, the terminal and the themes of the AI command-line tools are written from it by tools/generate.py.
principles: Different things appear in different colours, on condition that the colours suit each other. (the author, 2026-11-07)
What can be told apart is told apart, so that the user becomes aware of the difference. (the author, 2026-11-10)
A theme comes from a whole structure, not from the accident of single colours. (the author, 2026-11-07)
The pool is general: it holds classes that some tool cannot show. A tool takes the classes it can show and falls back for the rest. (the author, 2026-11-10)
Every colour was worked out one by one. A value the author decided is marked decided; a value added here is a proposal until the author decides.

reading.palette: the colours by name; a class names a colour, never a number
reading.roles: the classes. fg and bg name palette colours; style lists bold, italic, underline, strike; fallback is the class a tool uses when it cannot show this one

state.decided: the author's decision, with its source
state.in-use: what is drawn today without a recorded decision of its own
state.open: two decisions meet in one class, or the value is in doubt

reading.alt: other values on record for the same class: what another berkeDark medium uses, what is drawn today, or a second candidate
reading.claude-code: how Claude Code could show the class: terminal (foot.ini), theme (its theme file), interpreter (our colour interpreter), as drawn, or none
reading.mark: the sign a class is drawn with, where one is decided or in use

media.foot: the terminal: canvas, text, the sixteen ansi colours, cursor, selection (foot.ini)
media.zsh: the prompt and, with a highlighter, the command line (oh-my-zsh theme)
media.claude-code: theme file for interface classes; our interpreter for text classes; see each class
media.vscode: the published theme: token rules for the code classes, workbench keys for the ui classes
media.qwen-code: its own truecolour theme, written from the pool as cli/qwen/berkeDark.json (2026-11-10): about fifteen colours; a number in code shares the success colour, a string the warning colour, a mapping's key the inline code colour; no colours for headings or list marks; plain text is left to the terminal
media.codex: a syntax theme (.tmTheme), written from the pool as cli/codex/berkedark.tmTheme (2026-11-10): it colours rendered Markdown (heading levels, bold, italic, links, quotes, list marks, inline code) and code; a table's header takes the type colour; the rest of the interface is its own
media.grok: no theme file can be given; with theme = "terminal" it draws with the terminal's sixteen colours, the ansi classes

kept.note: decisions of the published theme that are not sorted into classes yet; they stay valid as they are. A value is a palette name, name/alpha, role:CLASS or bg:CLASS
